mika: Kickoff for Starlight Health POC — they need browser clients + on-prem proxy, streaming websocket, and in-band function calls that return strict JSON for discharge summaries. Need short runbook, pricing estimate for ~3k concurrent streams, and a security checklist.

raj: Quick Q — will they use our JS SDK in-browser or custom ws?

mika: JS SDK preferred. Proxy will issue ephemeral tokens and redact PHI before anything leaves their network.

clare: For 3k streams Dedicated estimate ~7k/mo committed depending on token usage. Private if they insist on guaranteed PHI isolation. I'll put numbers in a sheet.

raj: Integration notes: include handshake snippet for ephemeral creds, resume token example, and short JS streaming sample: `const s = client.stream({model:'redwood-stream'}); s.on('message', m=>handle(m));`

clare: For function calls require strict JSON Schema and server-side validation before executing any tool. Example schema: patient_id string maxLength 64, summary_type enum, include_sensitive boolean.

sec-bot: [automated] Checklist item: "Starlight POC - security packet requested" created by mika at 1865554321

mika: Action items: Raj -> SDK + handshake snippets; Clare -> pricing + schema sample; I'll assemble runbook and send to customer. Ping here with blockers. :thumbsup:
